bootstrap.resampling: One shared UID multiset per draw for every release and method, including idle selected users.
bootstrap.interval: Two-sided percentile95, linear quantiles; no clipping or redrawing. Ratio draws with nonpositive reference gain are undefined and counted.

quality.estimand: Equal-release mean AUC gains. Preservation divides partial-minus-Reuse by full-current-code-minus-Reuse; Rebuild recovery uses a separate native first-request rebuilding denominator.
quality.scope: Selected user panel and fixed models; no training-seed replication or adjustment for exploratory selection. A positive point retention is not a noninferiority result.
